tests.description: Creates a new user with a valid email and default role.
tests.contractClause: Creates a new user account and returns the newly created User.

tests.description: Creates a user with an explicitly provided ADMIN role.
tests.contractClause: Role parameter is optional; when provided it is applied to the created user.

tests.description: Rejects creation when a user with the same email already exists.
tests.contractClause: Throws EMAIL_TAKEN when a user with this email already exists.

tests.description: Rejects creation when email format is invalid.
tests.contractClause: Throws INVALID_EMAIL when email does not match valid format.

tests.description: Returns the user matching the given ID.
tests.contractClause: Fetches a user by ID and returns the matching User.

tests.description: Throws NOT_FOUND when no user exists with the given ID.
tests.contractClause: Throws NOT_FOUND when no user exists with this ID.

tests.description: Creates an order with valid user and in-stock items.
tests.contractClause: Creates a new order for a user and returns it with PENDING status.

tests.description: Creates an order with the maximum allowed quantity per item.
tests.contractClause: Items array may contain any quantity provided stock is sufficient.

tests.description: Creates an order with multiple distinct items.
tests.contractClause: Items array may contain multiple products.

tests.description: Throws USER_NOT_FOUND when userId does not match any user.
tests.contractClause: Throws USER_NOT_FOUND when userId does not match any user.

tests.description: Throws EMPTY_ORDER when items array is empty.
tests.contractClause: Throws EMPTY_ORDER when items array is empty.

tests.description: Throws INSUFFICIENT_STOCK when a product has less stock than requested.
tests.contractClause: Throws INSUFFICIENT_STOCK when one or more products have insufficient stock.

tests.description: Cancels a PENDING order and returns it with CANCELLED status.
tests.contractClause: Cancels an order if not yet shipped and returns it with CANCELLED status.

tests.description: Cancels a PAID order that has not yet been shipped.
tests.contractClause: Cancellation is permitted when status is not SHIPPED or DELIVERED.

tests.description: Throws NOT_FOUND when orderId does not match any order.
tests.contractClause: Throws NOT_FOUND when no order exists with this ID.

tests.description: Throws ALREADY_SHIPPED when order status is SHIPPED.
tests.contractClause: Throws ALREADY_SHIPPED when order status is SHIPPED or DELIVERED.

tests.description: Returns the product matching the given ID.
tests.contractClause: Fetches a product by ID and returns the matching Product.

tests.description: Throws NOT_FOUND when no product exists with the given ID.
tests.contractClause: Throws NOT_FOUND when no product exists with this ID.
